name: slippage_min_floor
description: A tiny order on a deep book: the square-root term is 0.2 bps, so the 2 bps minimum floor binds. y=1.0 and min_bps=2.0 are the spec defaults, passed explicitly.
derivation: order_notional=1e6, daily_vol=0.02, adv_notional=1e12, y=1.0, min_bps=2.0. ratio=1e6/1e12=1e-6; sqrt=1e-3; raw=y*daily_vol*sqrt(ratio)*1e4=1.0*0.02*1e-3*1e4=0.2 bps. slippage=max(2.0, 0.2)=2.0 bps.
